Computing, AI, And Cybersecurity
Take the Lead in Computing, AI, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, and Technology
Students at NSU’s College of Computing, AI, and Cybersecurity prepare for some of the fastest growing and highest paid careers in today’s economy. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (bls.gov), computing and IT occupations earn a median salary of nearly $106,000 per year, with demand projected to grow much faster than average through the next decade. Roles such as data scientists, information security analysts, AI engineers, and software developers routinely command six figure salaries and offer strong long term career stability. Graduates are prepared for in-demand roles including, but not limited to:
Information Security Analysts earn a median salary of $124,910, with 29% job growth projected through 2034. (bls.gov)
Data Scientists earn a median salary of $112,590, with employment projected to grow 34% over the same period. (bls.gov)
Global workforce data shows that AI and big data, networks and cybersecurity, and technological literacy are among the fastest‑growing skill areas through 2030, alongside rising demand for creative thinking, adaptability, and lifelong learning—skills critical for long-term success in technology leadership roles. (World Economic Forum)
Flexible programs designed for working professionals. Our graduate programs are built for career momentum. With fully online, in person, and hybrid options - and just 30 credits to complete a master’s degree - students can advance their careers without pausing their lives. With no residency requirements, NSU’s Ph.D. programs allow students to pursue advanced credentials from anywhere.
NSU’s College of Computing, AI, and Cybersecurity is continually evolving to stay ahead of industry needs. Our curricula focus on problem solving, adaptability, and leadership, so graduates understand not just today’s tools - but how to innovate as technology changes. In addition to deep technical expertise, students develop communication and leadership skills sought by Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies. An AI-focused graduate program at NSU can improve career outcomes with credibility and hiring processes use graduate degrees as a filter and implies you are ready and durable under pressure from expert guidance and feedback.
The tech world needs leaders like you - and the opportunities have never been greater.
Apply Now
Why Earn Your Degree From NSU?
Cybersecurity Designations
NSU is nationally recognized by the NSA as a Center of Academic Excellence, with multiple M.S. and Ph.D. programs earning top designations in Cyber Defense, AI in Cybersecurity, and cybersecurity research.
Your Degree On Your Time
You can advance your future even faster with 100% online master’s programs designed to be completed in one year. Graduate students can study on campus or online, giving you the flexibility to continue working while you earn your degree.
Competitive Advantage
As an R1 Carnegie–classified institution, we focus on the latest trends and high-demand degree programs. Our curriculum is aligned with insights from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and prepares students for careers recognized in U.S. News & World Report’s 100 Best Jobs. Our alumni work at Fortune 500 companies, federal and government agencies, and universities around the world.
Cybersecurity Designations
NSU's M.S. Artificial Intelligence Cybersecurity program is validated by the NSA as a designated Artificial Intelligence in Cybersecurity (AICyber) Program of Study, and the M.S. Cyber Defense and M.S. Cybersecurity Management programs are validated by the NSA as designated Cyber Defense (CD) Programs of Study.
NSU’s Ph.D. Computer Science, Ph.D. Cybersecurity Management, and Ph.D. Information Systems programs are validated by the NSA under the CAE-R designation.
Top Ranked by Fortune
From cybersecurity to information technology, you’ll have your choice of highly ranked programs.
